QuestInfo.name: Make a Golden Song Pyun Set!
QuestInfo.0: You can't celebrate Moon Festival without making a Song Pyun Gift Set. Now comes the fourth challenge! It's time to make a Golden Song Pyun Set. Click on the Moon Festival Event Notifier on the left side of your screen to get some Golden Song Pyuns to make a gift set.
QuestInfo.1: You are making a Golden Song Pyun gift set now. Remember! You can't get any Golden Song Pyuns from the monsters that are 11 or more levels below you and 21 or more levels higher than you.
QuestInfo.2: You've completed a Golden Song Pyun Set! You can try again after 5 minutes. Once you make 10 Golden Song Pyun Sets, you will get a Golden Song Pyun Necklace which you eagerly awaited!
